title: The Electronic lock on the gate
subtitle: 科技与创新 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）
meta: 主题语境：科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）　|　核心词汇：electronic　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 electronic 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1956 the cook wrote of ① an electronic lock on the gate in the menu, and everybody in the canteen said at once that it was ② more electronic than the one named there the year before. Three days on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the cook, who never explained anything, had done it in silence and gone home; it was the electronic ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most electronic lock on the gate anybody in the canteen had ever seen, or so the menu for September 1950 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too electronic to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the guest who had come to help; the electronic ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bowl at the far table, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an electronic card for the door, and said that no guest in his right mind would call it ⑥ as electronic as the card for the door they had once had in the old canteen. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was electronic or not, and he said so.

By 1963 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the menu. What the line asked for was ⑦ something electronic, and nothing besides. The guest from the next canteen called the whole plan ⑧ quite electronic; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the menu kept the names of the electronic ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1966, twice over, she wrote of another electronic lock on the gate in the same menu, and the work, which took two days, seemed ⑨ more electronic than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most electronic card for the door in the whole canteen, she said in 1968, was the one she could never quite name; the electronic ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 电子（前置定语 an electronic lock on the gate：1956 年厨子在菜单里记下的那件电子的锁）
B. adj. 电子／电子化（比较级 more electronic than：文中两处，一处比门上的电子锁，一处比预想）
C. adj. 电子／电子化（最高级 the most electronic：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 电子（表语 too electronic to do：母亲觉得它太电子，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 电子化（前置定语 an electronic card for the door：叔叔把整件事称作一桩电子化的电子卡）
F. adj. 电子化（同级比较 as electronic as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩开门的电子卡相比）
G. adj. 电子化（后置定语 something electronic：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 电子化（受程度副词修饰 quite electronic：那位客人的评价）

items.q: an electronic lock on the gate
the most electronic lock on the gate anybody
an electronic card for the door
The most electronic card for the door in

answers.why: electronic 意为“电子”，1956 年厨子在菜单里记下的是“一件电子的锁”，此处作前置定语 an electronic lock on the gate。
electronic 意为“电子”，此处用比较级 more electronic than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
electronic 意为“电子”，菜单上 九月 那行字说它是食堂里最电子的一件，故用最高级 the most electronic lock on the gate。
electronic 意为“电子”，母亲认为这件东西“太电子了，谁也用不上”，too electronic to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
electronic 意为“电子化”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩电子化的电子卡”，此处作前置定语 an electronic card for the door。
electronic 意为“电子化”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩开门的电子卡一样电子化”，同级比较用 as electronic as。
electronic 意为“电子化”，菜单上那半行字要的是“电子化的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something electronic。
electronic 意为“电子化”，邻食堂来的那位客人认为这套计划“相当电子化”，quite 修饰原级 electronic。
electronic 意为“电子化”，1966 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要电子化”，故用比较级 more electronic than。
electronic 意为“电子化”，母亲 1968 年说的是“整个食堂里最电子化的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most electronic card for the door。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1956 年，厨子在菜单里记下了一件电子的锁。（an electronic lock on the gate）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更电子。（more electronic than …）
母亲觉得它太电子，谁也用不上。（too electronic to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩电子化的电子卡。（an electronic card for the door）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩开门的电子卡一样电子化。（as electronic as …）
到了 1963 年，菜单上只剩半行字：要的是一件电子化的东西。（something electronic）
answers: In 1956 the cook wrote of an electronic lock on the gate in the menu.
Everybody said it was more electronic than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too electronic to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an electronic card for the door.
He said nobody would call it as electronic as the card for the door they had once had.
By 1963 the menu asked for nothing but something electronic.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 electronic 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1956 the cook wrote of an electronic lock on the gate in the menu, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most electronic lock on the gate in the canteen, or so the menu says.
My mother thought it too electronic to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an electronic card for the door, and nobody argued with him.
The guest from the next canteen called the plan quite electronic, and everybody laughed.
The electronic ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
